The '''Medal of Alderaan''' was a medal awarded to honor exceptional heroes of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. It was designed by a craftsman from [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] who survived the destruction of his home [[Planet/Legends|planet]].<ref name="CSWE" /> The Medal of Alderaan shared the same design as the [[Medal of Bravery/Legends|Medal of Yavin]].<ref name="CSWE" /><ref name="CSWE2">{{CSWECite|II|300|Medal of Bravery}}</ref>
